diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

null_resource.delete_daemonset removes the AWS VPC CNI (aws-node DaemonSet) from the cluster, but only waits for the cluster to exist (module.eks / null_resource.update_kubeconfig). This deployment uses Calico as the CNI (via null_resource.apply_tigera_operator → null_resource.create_calico_installation). The aws-node DaemonSet must only be deleted AFTER the Calico operator and Installation are in place, otherwise nodes lose pod networking. There is no attribute reference or depends_on linking delete_daemonset to the Calico installation resources, so Terraform may run the deletion before Calico is functional.

null_resource.update_kubeconfig has an explicit depends_on on module.eks, but the provisioner command already references module.eks.cluster_name (and triggers/timestamp aside, the command interpolates module.eks attributes), so the dependency is already established via an ordinary attribute reference. The explicit depends_on duplicates it.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class has an explicit depends_on on module.eks, but its `triggers` block already references module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id and module.eks.cluster_security_group_id, establishing the dependency implicitly via attribute references. The explicit depends_on duplicates it.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class has an explicit depends_on on module.karpenter, but its `triggers` block already references module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn (used as the role_arn trigger), so the dependency on module.karpenter is already established implicitly. The explicit depends_on duplicates it.

helm_release.karpenter has an explicit depends_on on data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster, but helm_release is provisioned with the helm provider, whose configuration already references data.aws_eks_cluster.cluster and data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster (host/token/cluster_ca_certificate). Terraform already orders resources after the data sources referenced in their provider configuration, so the explicit depends_on duplicates a dependency that is established through the provider chain.
